user: strategic-resource-deposit checks gating harvesting technologies on having encountered the resource -- every empire can obtain all of them; rarity (living metal especially) varies by playthrough luck, not by empire type, and "can this empire type get it" is the question this tool answers

user: the flag counterpart of the same strategic-resource-discovery mechanism, same reasoning -- matched by the `_found` suffix the corpus's resource-discovery flags all share (sr_dark_matter_found, rare_crystals_found, volatile_motes_found, negative_mass_found, exotic_gases_found, sr_living_metal_found, giga_sr_amb_megaconstruction_found); does NOT match an unrelated flag that merely contains "found" elsewhere in its name (e.g. `found_presapients`) or a same-key, different-meaning flag (e.g. `has_market_access`)
